<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Dwarf Warrior](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2965)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Between their finely crafted equipment and natural bravery, a dwarf warrior can hold their ground against mighty foes. If respected, these warriors can become life-long allies; if slighted, they can become a thorn in one's side for the remainder of one's life.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 15

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 13

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 10
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Dwarf_Warrior.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 1">[Dwarf Warrior](/NPCs.aspx?ID=2965)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Dwarf" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=584" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 135

**Perception** +7; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Dwarven](/Languages.aspx?ID=3)

**Skills**
[Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +7, [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) +5, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +3, [Dwarven Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +5

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +4

**Dex** +1

**Con** +3

**Int** +1

**Wis** +3

**Cha** -1
</row>

**Items**
[Half Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=12), [Steel Shield](/Shields.aspx?ID=3) (Hardness 5, HP 20, BT 10), [warhammer](/Equipment.aspx?ID=24)

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 17 

**Fort** +8 

**Ref** +3 

**Will** +5 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 20

</row>

**[Shield Block](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=75)** <actions string="Reaction" /> 

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 20 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
warhammer +8 ([Shove](/Traits.aspx?ID=193)),
**Damage** 1d8+2 bludgeoning

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
clan dagger +8 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Parry](/Traits.aspx?ID=190), [versatile B](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)),
**Damage** 1d4+2 piercing

**Dwarven Doughtiness**   A dwarf is often calm and collected in the face of imminent danger. At the end of this dwarf's turn, reduce their [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) condition by 2 instead of 1.

**Shielded Charge** <actions string="Two Actions" />  The dwarf warrior [Raises a Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=2316) and Strides twice.

</column>
